title: tephroseris porphyrantha
intro: Tephroseris porphyrantha, commonly known as the Alpine Marsh-marigold, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of certain conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Tephroseris porphyrantha are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exert antimicrobial effects, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
